entries.title: Choose how each integration action is allowed
entries.body: Every integration action starts by asking you, including connections you already have. The app shows your crewmate’s reason and the exact call. Choose Always allow or Only this time; changes and sends highlight Only this time. Change an action’s allowance in Integrations, beside its Off switch.

picture.alt: An integration approval card shows the crewmate’s reason, the exact call, and Always allow, Only this time and Not now.
